paper_contract.statement: The entropy-regularized variational problem (2) is equivalent to a Schrodinger half-bridge problem with the second marginal fixed to rho_0; conditional disintegration turns it into an expected KL minimization whose minimizer is the conditional Gibbs density.

domain.spaces: sigma-finite measured spaces X and Y
domain.admissibility: joint laws Pi with X-marginal rho_0, a conditional density q_x on Y, finite displayed objective, and 0 < Z_x < infinity for rho_0-almost every x

acceptance_criteria: Eliminating the free Y-marginal leaves exactly the joint half-bridge objective.
The conditional integrand identity J_x(q)=a KL(q||p_x)-a log Z_x is symbolically zero after a=epsilon/(2 tau) and p_x proportional to exp(-A_x/a).
Independent continuous quadrature normalizes p_x and observes the identity, stationarity, and strict increases under nonzero feasible perturbations.
A wrong-temperature Gibbs control exits nonzero for the intended stationarity violation.
The cumulative verifier exits nonzero if any accepted result or expected control behavior changes.
scope_note: The proof certificate supplies the universal functional argument. Finite numerical cases are only independent regression and sign/coefficient checks.
